# Merge-rule gate on the fine-tuned model, fold 1 OOF outputs

**Provenance.** OOF run `oof_native_fold1_4c17aa3`, generated by `uv run python scripts/rule_gate.py --oof-run-dir` (repo state `f725575+dirty`; paired bootstrap 2000 doc-level resamples, seed 42; unmodified scorer via `shipdoc.eval`). **All numbers UNVERIFIED** until a verifier recomputes them. Aggregates and counts only.

**Run.** fold 1; adapter sha256 `4cbb2ffe885028e2246f3d53d8267ff6fb541b7111c603d234af672a2f605cad`; training code SHA `4c17aa3c33c09f0cda7bb1f625947a1143a8cb28`; batch used 4; guard ran True, fallback to batch 1 False; adapter verification ok True.

**Policy.** The frozen rules are unchanged (no re-tuning on these outputs). A rule ships with the fine-tuned model only if it passes on this fold's OOF outputs too (in addition to its zero-shot gate). Ship rule as before: paired 95% CI lower bound > 0 AND broken == 0 (R3 also no group with net < 0). R1 / R2 have no learned parameters and run on this fold's 165 held-out docs; R3 shapes come only from the other folds' gold.

**Power caveat.** With 165 docs R1 / R2 may lack power. A rule whose CI includes 0 with 0 broken (point delta > 0) is reported 'NOT SHIPPABLE ON THIS EVIDENCE (insufficient power)'; one with broken > 0 is 'FAILED (broken > 0)'. The verdict string is DO NOT SHIP either way.
